biggest_catch: Both offers hinge on the friend's activity within 60 days: $500+ in direct deposits OR 5+ debit transactions for personal checking; the personal checking offer itself is light-touch.
catches: Friend must complete within 60 days: $500+ in direct deposits OR 5+ debit card transactions (excluding ATM withdrawals).
Cap: up to $500 per calendar year in reward cards.
Payout is a Mastercard Reward Card, not cash.
Reward card delivery takes 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Bank Independent's official page (bibank.com/refer-a-friend) runs a Refer-A-Friend program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns a $50 MasterCard Reward Card for each friend who opens a new personal checking account and completes the qualification, up to $500 per calendar year (i.e., 10 paid referrals). A separate business checking referral pays the referrer $50 with a $150 card for the friend.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: register via the on-page form and invite friends by contact info/email or social media; the friend registers through the personal referral link, opens a new Bank Independent personal checking account, and within 60 days completes either $500+ in direct deposits or 5+ debit card transactions (excluding ATM withdrawals).

c4.evidence: Timing: allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the Reward Card after completing all offer requirements.

eligibility: Bank Independent customers referring friends who open a new personal checking account.

steps: Register via the form on bibank.com/refer-a-friend.
Invite friends/family with their contact info and email, or share via social media.
Friend registers through your personal referral link and opens a new personal checking account.
Friend completes within 60 days: $500+ in direct deposits OR 5+ debit card transactions (no ATM withdrawals).
You both receive a MasterCard Reward Card; allow 4-6 weeks for delivery.
timing: Allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the Reward Card after completing all offer requirements.
when_cash_arrives: Allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the Reward Card after completing all offer requirements. The payout clock starts when your friend finishes qualifying, and the reward arrives as a mailed (or emailed) Reward Card 4-6 weeks later.
maximize: Start the clock ASAP: the 4-6-week card window only begins after your friend completes every requirement - have them qualify in the first days of the window, not the last.
Front-load the friend's activity (debit transactions, direct deposit) so verification does not push delivery past 6 weeks.
Watch for a redemption email - some ReferLive programs issue virtual cards faster than physical mail.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: payout is a Reward Card with a 4-6-week delivery window baked into the terms - qualification speed is the only lever.
